title: For party
text: For party. I have bunco in October so my "theme" is always halloween.  We eat small bites of things we can easily carry around, so these plates are perfect.  There were other choices, I chose these because they were dishwasher safe.  Better for the environment that use and disposing of paperplates.  So I took the dive.  They are very cute and will be useful for years!
